ingredients:
breadsticks: enriched flour (wheat flour, niacin, reduced iron, thiamine mononitrate {vitamin b1}, riboflavin {vitamin b2}, folic acid), sugar, margarine (partially hydrogenated soybean and/or cottonseed oils, skim milk, cultured skim milk, salt, emulsifiers \[vegetable mono and diglycerides and soy lecithin], vitamin a palmitate, beta carotene \[color], artificial flavor), partially hydrogenated soybean oil, salt, cheese powder (cheddar cheese \[milk, cheese cultures, salt, enzymes], cream, sodium phosphate, salt, annatto, lactic acid), skim milk, autolyzed yeast extract, baking soda

cheese dip: whey, whey protein concentrate, cheddar cheese (milk, cheese cultures, salt, enzymes), canola oil, water, milk protein concentrate, sodium phosphate, salt, maltodextrin, lactic acid, milkfat, sodium phosphate, sodium alginate, sorbic acid (preservative), natural and artificial flavor, apocarotenal (color), annatto extract (color).
